description: Defines custom formatters for PDCCH-related data structures in a 5G NR PHY layer, including coreset descriptions and PDU formatting.

classes.name: formatter<ocudu::pdcch_processor::coreset_description>
classes.description: Custom formatter for coreset_description structure, formats BWP, symbols, frequency resources, and mapping type.

classes.name: formatter<ocudu::pdcch_processor::pdu_t>
classes.description: Custom formatter for pdu_t structure, formats RNTI, slot, control info, and DCI details.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses formatting options for the formatter.

methods.name: format
methods.description: Formats the respective data structure into a string representation.
